voice_policy: plain modern English; the sutta’s wishes kept close to the translation; no promises of results

lines.text: Standing, walking, sitting or lying down: any posture, as long as you are not drowsy.
Think: happy, at rest, may all beings be happy at heart.

quote.text: may all beings be happy at heart.

lines.text: Whatever beings there may be, weak or strong, seen or unseen, near or far, born or seeking birth: may all beings be happy at heart.
Let no one deceive another, or despise anyone anywhere, or wish for another to suffer.
As a mother would protect her only child, protect this goodwill toward all beings.

quote.text: One should protect one’s goodwill toward all beings in the same way that a mother would protect her only child.

lines.text: With goodwill for the entire cosmos, let the heart go out without limit: above, below, and all around.
